Partnership with MD PHD Wellness Establishes a Long-Term Product Pipeline; Flagship Formulation to Be Marketed Under Synbio’s Healing Force™ Brand
NEW YORK, NY – TheNewswire - Sept. 8, 2026 – Synbio International, Inc.

today announced it has entered into a Strategic Licensing, Manufacturing, Supply and Revenue Sharing Agreement with MD PHD Wellness, Inc., securing the exclusive rights to commercialize MD PHD Wellness’ proprietary nutraceutical formulations throughout the United States and Canada.

The agreement covers MD PHD Wellness’ flagship anti-anxiety nutraceutical formulation, to be marketed under Synbio’s Healing Force™ brand, and establishes a framework for the parties to evaluate and commercialize additional proprietary wellness products over time. Importantly, it provides Synbio with immediate access to proprietary nutraceutical products without the time and cost burden of developing formulations from scratch, significantly accelerating the Company’s path to revenue generation.

Under the agreement, MD PHD Wellness will oversee product development, manufacturing, quality assurance, and supply chain management, while Synbio will be responsible for branding, marketing, sales, and distribution. Following recovery of approved manufacturing and commercialization costs, profits generated from product sales will be shared between the parties.

“This agreement represents a transformational milestone for Synbio,” said Claudio Solitario, Chief Executive Officer of Synbio International. “Rather than building a nutraceutical business product by product, we have established a strategic partnership that combines MD PHD’s product development and manufacturing expertise with Synbio’s commercialization capabilities. It gives Synbio immediate access to proprietary products capable of generating near-term commercial revenue while establishing a framework to expand our wellness portfolio over time, allowing management to focus on creating the greatest shareholder value — building brands, generating sales and expanding market presence.”

Solitario continued, “We believe this partnership creates an efficient and scalable business model. As the global nutraceutical market continues its rapid expansion, Synbio is now positioned to participate through a growing portfolio of scientifically developed products while simultaneously advancing our longer-term AI-driven healthcare technologies.”
Scientific Leadership

MD PHD Wellness was founded by Dr. Robert Lawrence, a physician, scientist and inventor who holds two Ph.D. degrees, in Nuclear Physics and Biomedical Engineering, and whose career spans medicine, biomedical engineering, microbiology, pharmacology and nutraceutical development. He has developed numerous nutraceutical products, and his research includes innovations in cellular regeneration, natural product delivery systems, medical technologies and pharmaceutical applications.

Co-founder Dr. David Anderson is an experienced physician, researcher and scientific consultant who played a key role in developing the proprietary formulations licensed to Synbio, with extensive expertise in nutraceuticals, medical technologies and scientific claims substantiation. He served as a Research Physician and Senior Research Scientist at a prominent New York-based university, where he participated in the evaluation and scientific validation of therapeutics, nutraceuticals and emerging healthcare technologies. His work has included collaborations with leading academic institutions, government agencies and commercial organizations, and he has been recognized in Marquis Who’s Who for his professional achievements.
Building a Diversified Healthcare Company

The agreement advances Synbio’s broader strategy of building a diversified healthcare company that pairs near-term revenue from commercial wellness products with longer-term value creation from its AI-driven mental health technologies — a dual-track approach the Company believes provides multiple avenues for growth while establishing recurring commercial revenue that can support continued investment in innovation.
About Synbio International Inc.

Synbio International Inc (SYIN) is a company focused on clinically validating an AI-driven software that will screen for mental health conditions using facial analysis. Through strategic partnerships and research collaborations, Synbio aims to help develop and validate science-based solutions that improve the quality of life and empower healthcare providers. To generate early revenue while its software advances through validation, Synbio plans to launch a line of nutraceutical products sold directly to consumers online in 2026.
